the spin-structures on a real manifold are equivalent to the holomorphic spin structures on the complexification of the manifold, that the spinor bundle on a real manifold is the holomorphic spinor bundle on the complexification, and the Dirac operators on these manifolds are the same.

(i) a real spin structure can be viewed as the complex spin structure on the underlying complexification of the real manifold, (ii) the real spinor bundle on the real spin structure is the complexified holomorphic spinor bundle on its complexification, (iii) the real Dirac operator on the real spin manifold is the complex Dirac operator on its complexification.
the complex Dirac operator on the complex manifold is the same as the real Dirac operator on its realification.
